messages.subject: SCG Chemicals | Circular industry, sustainability and stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Mr. Patiparnpreechavud and SCG Chemicals Leadership Team,

SCG Chemicals' focus on innovation, circularity and sustainable industrial growth makes the company a strong match for my experience in ESG, government relations and operating execution.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My role connects senior leadership with ministries, regulators, communities, industry stakeholders and internal technical teams across a complex mining and energy environment.

I bring a practical approach to sustainability. My recent work includes stakeholder and governance support around a large solar and battery-storage transition, carbon-data readiness based on physical operating evidence, social-performance coordination and multi-agency regulatory engagement. I am used to turning external expectations into named owners, timelines, evidence requirements and executive escalation paths.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or regional roles in Sustainability, Corporate Affairs, Government Relations, Strategic Partnerships or stakeholder leadership. I have attached an SCG Chemicals-focused executive CV showing where I believe my background would add value to the company's industrial transformation agenda.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
